author: Victor2026
quote: Grand Theft Auto has always been a mirror of the current state of our society, and the newest game is no different. Only this time, it's not funny anymore. The game is woke; it focuses on realism when, in the past, it was the fun and chaotic gameplay that made previous GTAs great, and it's a downright evil game. Save your money.

author: Victor2026
quote: Nintendo managed to lovingly recreate a classic without losing the essence of what made the game such a masterpiece during the ‘ 90s. The presentation is superb, and while there are few quirks such as the lack of DLSS and loading screens, albeit short ones, in between areas, it doesn't hamper the enjoyment one bit. If you've ever wondered why old people love this game so much, now is the perfect time to experience it for yourself.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
